description:
Welcome to our official licensed Anime and Pop culture online store! We are dedicated to bringing you the best and most authentic merchandise from your favorite anime series, manga, video games, and pop culture icons. Our store is a haven for fans who want to showcase their love and passion for these beloved franchises through high-quality products.   We sell Naruto, Dragon ball z, Sailor Moon, My Hero Academia and many more 

At our online store, you will find an extensive range of products that cater to all your anime and pop culture needs. From Cookware such as Ramen Bowls, Sushi Sets and Chopsticks set.  Drinkware including Water Bottles, Coffer Mugs, Pint and Shot glasses set, home decor Blankets, Wall Art, Pillow Set etc. we have everything to satisfy your fandom desires. Our products are carefully selected to ensure they meet the highest standards of quality and reflect the essence of the characters and worlds you adore. 

What sets us apart from other online stores is our commitment to official licensing. We work directly with renowned anime brands and pop culture brands to obtain official licenses for our products. This means you can shop with confidence, knowing that you are supporting the creators and artists behind your favorite franchises. Our dedication to authenticity guarantees that you will receive genuine merchandise that accurately represents the characters and stories you love. 

We offer convenient and secure payment options such as Paypal and card payment to ensure smooth and pleasent experience. Our pay cycle, Pay-per-Sale (PPS): In this model, the affiliate marketer receives a commission for each sale generated through their unique affiliate link. The payment is typically a percentage of the total sale amount. The payment schedule can vary, Payments are usually made in 45 to account for potential returns or cancellations.  The affiliate marketer may need to accumulate at least $50 in commissions before receiving a payout. 

Shipping: We strive to deliver your orders swiftly and efficiently. Our shipping options include both domestic in US only allowing fans from all around the world to enjoy our products. Shipping rates and estimated delivery times will be provided during the checkout process. Our Orders ships in 2-3 days. 

 

Customer Support: We have a dedicated customer support team ready to assist you with any inquiries or concerns you may have. Feel free to reach out to us via email/Chat or through our contact form on the website, and we will respond promptly to ensure your satisfaction.

 

Affiliate Program: As part of our commitment to fostering a strong community, we offer an affiliate program for content creators and influencers. By joining our affiliate program, you can earn commissions by promoting our products and driving sales through your unique affiliate link. Further details on the program, commission rates, and application process can be found on our website's affiliate program page
